snapshot.scope: Source review of 0.5.3, including missing-account login work, explicit 128-row expired-Session maintenance, source Session-expiry and registry retirement/audit read guards. Source pins, shared password admission/profile checks, OTP freshness and schema-2 atomic consumption remain prepared-only. Missing accounts take bounded synthetic verification; cleanup validates complete selected rows. Invalid stored times are rejected before driver decoding in these scoped paths; invalid non-null retirement cannot become an active binding. No driver-wide time guarantee, complete enumeration defense, global storage quotas or automatic maintenance is supplied. Includes C2-K/L/M/N content preparation and unmounted HTTP routing, plus C2-O strict whole-draft parsing, pure publication planning and supplied-content binding; C2-O itself performs no actual publication or browser connection. Historical evidence retains its original scope; no public issuer, live cutover, migration or deployment acceptance. Capability slices, not every function, endpoint or execution path. C2-P separately composes create-only Session publication and Task creation with caller-owned in-memory outcomes, not public/browser wiring or durable recovery. C2-Q separately observes one unconfirmed target through the original current Session without changing attempt state or proving the earlier write outcome. C2-R exports bounded metadata checkpoints and strictly parses caller-supplied reported progress; no save, journal, provenance, authorization, restored attempt or read-on-import. C2-S separately inspects one reported unconfirmed checkpoint target through explicit trusted workspace/current Session and an existing reader, without a surviving attempt. This does not make parsing perform I/O, restore C2-Q, prove original caller/body/storage incarnation or add confirmation, journal or retry. AI host integration adds teacher-only connection metadata and explicitly selected SDK tool-format helpers, without provider calls, secret storage, autonomous participants/delegation or generic Task browser saving. C2-O–S, AI host integration, boundary simplification and Monaco sanitizer fixes are included in 0.5.3; Unreleased wording in dated evidence records retains the original implementation stage, not the current release status.
snapshot.verification: Source and scoped recorded-evidence inventory, with separately dated content/Session PostgreSQL runs, password-work units, hash-profile/freshness regressions, pure OTP policy, atomic-consumption/schema SQL, missing-account worker boundaries, explicit Session cleanup, source-expiry and registry-time read cases. C2-O adds separately scoped pure import/binding, publication-value and shared-fixture execution, not database or publication evidence. Generating or validating this inventory does not execute its referenced tests or establish deployment acceptance or security certification; scores are reviewer judgments scoped to each coordinate. C2-P has separate default state/confirmation units and exact disposable PostgreSQL execution, not browser or deployment acceptance. C2-Q has separately dated seven default units, twelve exact disposable PostgreSQL observations and three common guards; none establish historical commit outcome, durable recovery or public/browser connection. C2-R has separately dated six internal units, fourteen default contract cases and three common guards for the strict metadata codec; this is unit-record evidence, not inherited C2-P/C2-Q database execution, persistence or restart recovery. C2-S has separately dated six default units, twelve exact disposable PostgreSQL inspection cases and three common guards for current-authority metadata comparison. Prior publication, observation and codec runs are not its execution evidence; source-handle reopening is not process-crash durability, authenticated checkpoint history or restored publication. AI profiles and SDK adapters have separately dated file/route, cancellation, unit, browser-fixture and synthetic-format execution; these are unit-record evidence, not real-provider or deployment acceptance.

11 deterministic prepared password-work tests passed after a real unguarded cancellation regression. Covers 4 dispatched/20 total admission, waiting/running/Tokio-queued cancellation, timeout, panic/closed recovery, deferred secret copies, shared gate and real Argon2 semantics. Two source checks cover all five prepared call sites. Adjacent database and gate reruns are recorded separately; no single-job PHC cost limit, legacy AuthService limit, public issuer or CLI/deployment acceptance.

Six exact prepared PHC PostgreSQL cases plus 25 profile/worker units after a real low-cost-profile rejection regression. Fixed Argon2id v19/m19456/t2/p1/32-byte validation, writer compatibility, existing Session preservation and post-write rollback. Hostile costs are tested only by pure validation. No live-auth switch, credential migration, CLI/deployment acceptance or wall-clock/process RSS bound; adjacent suite and gate results are dated separately.

Historical freshness-only stage: seven exact library-test PostgreSQL cases and 11 pure OTP cases after a real writer-wait expiry regression. Private clocks and observed SQL waits/snapshot release cover rollback, success and same-window reuse; exact queue dispatch is not observed. At this stage production checked application UTC before requesting commit, with no consumption ledger or live switch. The later otp-consumption record covers atomic integration; neither record proves freshness at acknowledgement.

Historical pure-only stage: 16 policy tests and three dormant-boundary guards passed after an unimplemented seam failed 13 positive cases. Explicit watermarks, real collisions, bound exact-counter rechecks and byte/time limits only. At that stage login/rotation were unwired and schema 1 unchanged; this record is not atomic-consumption proof. The subsequent otp-consumption record covers integration.

11 exact atomic-consumption and four schema PostgreSQL cases passed after independent sources reproduced two successful uses of one code. Account-bound counter CAS, login/rotation competition, reopen/incarnations, write/commit/cancellation rollback, real collisions, genuine schema-1 refusal, schema-2 shape checks and fresh registration/bootstrap. Private clocks and disposable local SQL only; adjacent tests and gates are dated in project status. No public issuer, legacy switch, existing-data migration or commit-ack recovery proof.

Seven exact disposable PostgreSQL cases passed after missing-account early rejection failed the held-executor regression. Shared-gate permits demonstrate queued work and cancellation retention; a single-connection pool and metadata NOWAIT prove released SQL resources. Matching public dummy credentials, same-name creation during work, unchanged state, input/attempt/global limits and distinct storage/profile/source errors are covered. The fixed synthetic PHC is separately derived and verified in a unit test. Not a timing-equivalence benchmark, comprehensive enumeration defense, public issuer or live-auth switch.

Nine exact disposable PostgreSQL cases passed after an unimplemented maintenance seam failed the batch test and an infinite timestamp reproduced a SQLx chrono decoder panic. Explicit 128-row batches retain a real usable Session and OTP state; source isolation, independent pools, lock-fresh cutoff, corrupt/orphan refusal and hit-proven suppression/reinsertion/source-drift/commit/cancellation faults are covered. SQL projections reject unsafe text/time before decoding. Internal primitive only: no automatic cleanup, CLI/HTTP connection, full-source emptiness, global storage bound or audit of arbitrary trigger side effects.

Five new disposable PostgreSQL regression groups passed after Session validation and source reconciliation each reproduced a SQLx chrono decoder panic. Shared Session expiry rejects infinity and finite year 262143 before decoding; reconciliation selects a checked expiry boolean. Normal expiry and finite PostgreSQL/chrono bounds remain accepted. Login INSERT fault counters and complete synthetic row snapshots demonstrate OTP/Session rollback; password-change authorization and reconciliation preserve state on refusal. Original locks/cutoffs remain. Registry retirement and identity/policy audit timestamp decoding was a separate remaining slice at this stage, addressed by the later registry-time-reads record; no driver-wide, live-auth or dependency change is claimed.

Ten new exact PostgreSQL regression groups passed on a private disposable instance after retirement, lifecycle and policy reads reproduced the locked SQLx chrono panic. Fourteen decoder-producing projections guard nullable retirement and mandatory identity/policy audit times before decoding. A raw validity flag prevents invalid non-null retirement from reviving a binding through NULL; genuine NULL and finite PostgreSQL/chrono boundaries remain accepted. Healthy-head/invalid-old-receipt cases cover history/replay, hit-counted write faults and complete SQL snapshots cover rollback, and reconciliation preserves exact-stage refusal without writes. Schema LIMIT-0 activation probes bind the same range check. Sequence continuity, existing locks, budgets and snapshots are unchanged; no new age policy, repair, schema/dependency change, driver-wide guarantee or live cutover.

No public/browser dispatch, durable receipt/recovery, retry, cleanup, atomic workflow or deployed acceptance.

Unreleased C2-Q: seven default units, twelve exact PostgreSQL 16/private-socket cases and three common guards passed on 2026-10-07. Covers original-Session admission, current match/difference/visibility, damaged bytes, expiry, pending creators, cancellation and unchanged state/business data. A missing Task does not validate the Artifact namespace; Artifact reads may match an exact historical revision. Invisibility is not rollback, matching is not prior-write provenance, and no journal, recovery, retry, public route, browser or deployment acceptance is claimed.

Unreleased C2-R: six internal units, fourteen default contract cases and three common guards passed on 2026-10-07. Covers strict 64 KiB object-only metadata export/parse, visible duplicates, exact numeric forms, RFC UUIDv4 allocation identities, lengths/scope/unique references, progress and immutable export. Parsed progress remains forgeable/replayable caller data. Closed-pool and pure fixtures do not establish current authorization or database outcomes. No persistence, authenticated provenance, journal, restored attempt, read-on-import, retry, public/browser or deployment acceptance.

Unreleased C2-S: six default units, twelve exact PostgreSQL 16/private-socket inspection cases and three common guards passed on 2026-10-07. Covers parsed records after attempt drop/source-handle reopening, fresh current Session versus unchanged C2-Q fingerprint rules, owner filtering, observable metadata/text shape, typed failures, missing/empty Task scope, exact lock expiry, cancellation and pending creators with unchanged checkpoint/business data. Reopening handles is not a process-crash durability test. No original Session identity, original-byte provenance, storage-incarnation proof, historical confirmation, save/load, journal, restored attempt, retry, public/browser or deployment acceptance. C2-R parsing remains pure and C2-Q still requires its surviving original attempt.

gap.zh-CN: W10-W18 提供内部契约、发布、原尝试观察、检查点数据及显式当前授权检查；仍缺安全签发/安装、公共派发、持久日志/恢复身份及浏览器保存/读取/冲突处理。

gap.en: Inventory data, restore backups, fence old writers and review install/migration/rollback before routing.
gap.zh-CN: 先盘点数据、验证备份恢复、隔离旧写入方并审阅安装迁移回滚，再切换路由。

gap.en: Explicit content grants and reviewer delegation before any private-owner relaxation.
gap.zh-CN: 先建立内容分享权与审阅者委派，不放宽本人范围冒充协作。

gap.en: Bind exact bytes and policy/provider version to authorized typed evidence and stored judgment.
gap.zh-CN: 需将精确内容、策略与 provider 版本绑定到授权证据和持久判断。

gap.en: Define acceptance policy/state and explicit Review effect; execution success is insufficient.
gap.zh-CN: 缺验收策略、状态与 Review 影响定义；执行成功不够。

gap.en: Run reference exists, not scheduler/store; define inputs, leases, cancellation and restart reconciliation.
gap.zh-CN: 只有 Run 引用，无调度器与存储；缺输入、租约、取消和重启核对。

gap.en: Envelope and rows exist, not dispatcher, consumer deduplication or cursor replay.
gap.zh-CN: 只有信封与记录，无投递器、消费者去重或游标重放。

gap.en: Implement unprivileged control, VM ownership, reset/quarantine and cleanup acceptance.
gap.zh-CN: 缺无特权控制面、VM 归属、重置隔离与清理验收。

gap.en: Define file/process authorization, transport, lifecycle and resource isolation.
gap.zh-CN: 缺文件与进程授权、传输、生命周期和资源隔离。

gap.en: Agent principal is a type, not planner, tool authorization, budget or independent Review.
gap.zh-CN: Agent 主体只是类型，不是规划器、工具授权、预算或独立审阅。

gap.en: No implemented partner adapter; external project assumptions have not been verified.
gap.zh-CN: 无已实现合作项目适配器；外部项目假设未核实。

gap.en: Define installation, trust, runtime loading and revocation independently of manifests.
gap.zh-CN: 安装、信任、运行时加载与撤销须独立于声明清单设计。

boundary.en: Teacher Settings composition; client visibility never grants authority.
boundary.zh-CN: 教师设置组合；界面可见性不授予权限。

boundary.en: Private read then target/revision-bound replacement and exact acknowledgement; surviving failed saves require reload. Navigation discards memory drafts and late results, not server writes.
boundary.zh-CN: 私有读取后固定目标/修订替换并准确确认；存活页面失败保存要求重载。导航丢弃内存草稿及晚到结果，不撤销服务端写入。

boundary.en: Existing teacher/CSRF middleware, not a new Agent identity or Workspace grant.
boundary.zh-CN: 已有教师/CSRF中间件，不是新Agent身份或Workspace授权。

boundary.en: Instance-data metadata store without startup file writes or provider networking.
boundary.zh-CN: 实例数据元存储，启动不写配置文件、不连接模型。

boundary.en: Explicit reviewed tools use the existing SDK session; each mutation requires trusted host approval.
boundary.zh-CN: 明确审核工具经现有SDK会话派发；每个写操作需可信宿主批准。

boundary.en: Host loads teacher metadata explicitly; profile enablement grants no tool rights and does not resolve secrets.
boundary.zh-CN: 宿主显式加载教师配置；启用不授工具权、不解析密钥。

boundary.en: Legacy session gates the local page, not Task ownership on the server.
boundary.zh-CN: 旧会话只门禁本地页面，不建立服务端 Task 归属。

boundary.en: Parent accepted content/revision owns the selected model; stale callbacks are rejected.
boundary.zh-CN: 父级接受的内容与修订拥有选中模型；拒绝过期回调。

boundary.en: Language/model identity controls local providers; no source upload or execution.
boundary.zh-CN: 语言与模型身份控制本地 provider；不上传源码或执行。

boundary.en: Target-bound replacement checks bytes and filename before parent acceptance.
boundary.zh-CN: 目标绑定替换先核对字节与文件名，再由父级接纳。

boundary.en: File reads cannot bypass draft generation/revision checks.
boundary.zh-CN: 文件读取不能绕过草稿代次与修订核验。

boundary.en: Strict local JSON export/import preserves identities without server authority.
boundary.zh-CN: 严格本地 JSON 导入导出保留身份字段，但不产生服务端权威。

boundary.en: Confirmation names the current replacement target; cancellation preserves existing content.
boundary.zh-CN: 确认绑定当前替换目标；取消保留原内容。

boundary.en: Invitation consumption enters the normal account/session path; discovery alone grants nothing.
boundary.zh-CN: 消费邀请进入正常账号会话流程；发现本身不授予权限。

boundary.en: Engine derives the owner and enforces CSRF for writes.
boundary.zh-CN: Engine 派生所有者并对写入执行 CSRF 检查。

boundary.en: Loading a saved script is explicit; compilation and execution are separate actions.
boundary.zh-CN: 加载已存脚本需显式操作；编译与执行是独立动作。

boundary.en: The workbench can separately request a confirmed run; checking never auto-runs.
boundary.zh-CN: 工作台可另行请求确认运行；检查不自动执行。

boundary.en: Owner-scoped capacity admission precedes privileged local loading; leases are volatile.
boundary.zh-CN: 所有者容量准入先于特权加载；租约易失。

boundary.en: Run observations reach the trusted teaching pack, not arbitrary client evidence.
boundary.zh-CN: 运行观测进入受信任教学包，不接受任意客户端证据。

boundary.en: Teaching assessment becomes legacy attempts/feedback, not a generic Review.
boundary.zh-CN: 教学评估形成旧尝试与反馈，不是通用 Review。

boundary.en: Historical resume loads owner-bound source only; it does not rerun.
boundary.zh-CN: 历史恢复仅加载本人源码，不自动运行。

boundary.en: Runtime observations feed bounded owner telemetry; delivery can gap.
boundary.zh-CN: 运行观测进入有界所有者遥测；交付可能缺口。

boundary.en: Explicit remote compile selection creates an owner job; failure grants no local fallback.
boundary.zh-CN: 显式选择远程编译才创建本人作业；失败不授权本地回退。

boundary.en: Verified teacher-selected headers supply compile context; client metadata is not a snapshot.
boundary.zh-CN: 教师选择的校验头文件提供编译上下文；客户端元数据不是原子快照。

boundary.en: Current AppState constructs legacy AuthService, not DurableAuthSource.
boundary.zh-CN: 当前 AppState 构造旧 AuthService，不是 DurableAuthSource。

boundary.en: Explicit reviewed SSH apply targets a preinstalled package; no bare-host bootstrap.
boundary.zh-CN: 审阅后的显式 SSH apply 面向已装包，不初始化裸机。

boundary.en: Teacher inventory/probe/cancel uses confirmed identities; uncertain writes require read-back.
boundary.zh-CN: 教师清单、探针和取消使用已确认身份；不确定写入需重读核对。

boundary.en: Current Session/account/member are rechecked around private content publication.
boundary.zh-CN: 在私人内容发布前后复查当前 Session、账号与成员。

boundary.en: A separately published exact owned revision can be pinned as a Task input.
boundary.zh-CN: 独立发布的本人精确修订可固定为任务输入。

boundary.en: Draft replacement checks expected revision and the stable union of old/new inputs.
boundary.zh-CN: Draft 换版核对预期修订与旧新输入稳定并集。

boundary.en: Task revision and outbox record commit together; delivery is not part of the transaction.
boundary.zh-CN: 任务修订与 outbox 同事务提交；投递不在事务内。

boundary.en: The current Session adapter independently rechecks private ownership and exact Artifact targets/evidence before recording a human Review.
boundary.zh-CN: 当前会话适配器在写人工 Review 前，独立复查私人归属与精确 Artifact 目标及证据。

boundary.en: The Session adapter checks scope before and after immutable Review storage.
boundary.zh-CN: 会话适配在不可变审阅存储前后检查范围。

boundary.en: Actor resolution and final Session check share the command transaction.
boundary.zh-CN: actor 解析与最终 Session 复查共享命令事务。

boundary.en: Membership and deployment grants have separate audited authorization.
boundary.zh-CN: 成员与部署 Grant 分别执行审计授权。

boundary.en: Identity binding uses exact account incarnation and audited target state.
boundary.zh-CN: 身份绑定使用精确账号代次与审计目标状态。

boundary.en: Explicit empty-namespace apply initializes staged auth, without changing live configuration.
boundary.zh-CN: 显式空命名空间 apply 初始化准备层认证，不改变在线配置。

boundary.en: Bootstrap pins registry and source namespaces in one reviewed target.
boundary.zh-CN: 初始化将注册表与认证源命名空间固定在同一审阅目标。

boundary.en: Read-only reconciliation inspects a bounded snapshot; it cannot repair or authorize.
boundary.zh-CN: 只读核对检查有界快照，不修复或授权。

boundary.en: The admission handle freezes exact definition metadata, not a provider invocation.
boundary.zh-CN: 准入句柄冻结精确定义元数据，不调用 provider。

boundary.en: Catalogue Draft replacement retains the admitted definition and revision checks.
boundary.zh-CN: 目录 Draft 换版保留已准入定义与修订核验。

boundary.en: No explicit browser save/read/conflict adapter exists.
boundary.zh-CN: 尚无显式浏览器保存、重读与冲突适配。

boundary.en: Browser/public admission remains absent. W10/W11 do not compose current-Session authorization or publication of verified Artifact bytes.
boundary.zh-CN: 浏览器/公共准入仍缺失；W10/W11 尚未组合当前 Session 授权或经过校验的 Artifact 字节发布。

boundary.en: Legacy session cookies are not automatically staged durable Sessions.
boundary.zh-CN: 旧会话 cookie 不自动成为准备层持久 Session。

boundary.en: Reviewed migration, old-writer fencing and recovery precede live cutover.
boundary.zh-CN: 在线切换前需审阅迁移、旧写入隔离与恢复。

boundary.en: Private ownership cannot be relaxed by a teacher/deployment role.
boundary.zh-CN: 不能凭教师或部署角色放宽私人归属。

boundary.en: Exact byte revisions need an authorized typed-evidence conversion.
boundary.zh-CN: 精确内容修订还需授权的类型化证据转换。

boundary.en: No adapter persists verified provider/version-bound rule judgments.
boundary.zh-CN: 无适配器持久化经过验证且绑定 provider 版本的规则判断。

boundary.en: Review storage does not trigger Task acceptance.
boundary.zh-CN: 写入 Review 不触发任务验收。

boundary.en: Task state/references do not dispatch or cancel Runner jobs.
boundary.zh-CN: Task 状态与引用不派发或取消 Runner 作业。

boundary.en: No durable Run-to-lease execution adapter or restart reconciliation.
boundary.zh-CN: 无持久 Run 到租约的执行适配或重启核对。

boundary.en: Atomic rows do not provide delivery, deduplication or cursor replay.
boundary.zh-CN: 原子记录不提供投递、去重或游标重放。

boundary.en: Shared-kernel quotas do not create per-student VM ownership or isolation.
boundary.zh-CN: 共享内核配额不建立每学生 VM 归属或隔离。

boundary.en: Local workers do not provide external process or project filesystem access.
boundary.zh-CN: 本地 worker 不提供外部进程或项目文件系统访问。

boundary.en: Agent principal types do not implement bounded AI delegation.
boundary.zh-CN: Agent 主体类型不实现有界 AI 委派。

boundary.en: A public SDK is not a verified cross-product identity/content adapter.
boundary.zh-CN: 公共 SDK 不是已验证的跨产品身份内容适配器。

boundary.en: Declarative module control state does not execute a domain plugin.
boundary.zh-CN: 声明模块控制状态不执行领域插件。

boundary.en: Every command independently rechecks the current Session/account/member; earlier Artifact publication conveys no later authority.
boundary.zh-CN: 每次命令独立复查当前会话、账号与成员；此前 Artifact 发布不携带后续权限。

boundary.en: Every command independently rechecks the current Session/account/member; earlier Artifact publication conveys no later authority.
boundary.zh-CN: 每次命令独立复查当前会话、账号与成员；此前 Artifact 发布不携带后续权限。

boundary.en: Every command independently rechecks the current Session/account/member; earlier Artifact publication conveys no later authority.
boundary.zh-CN: 每次命令独立复查当前会话、账号与成员；此前 Artifact 发布不携带后续权限。

boundary.en: Every command independently rechecks the current Session/account/member; earlier Artifact publication conveys no later authority.
boundary.zh-CN: 每次命令独立复查当前会话、账号与成员；此前 Artifact 发布不携带后续权限。

boundary.en: Every command independently rechecks the current Session/account/member; earlier Artifact publication conveys no later authority.
boundary.zh-CN: 每次命令独立复查当前会话、账号与成员；此前 Artifact 发布不携带后续权限。

boundary.en: This store commits its resource change and outbox record atomically; it does not deliver the event.
boundary.zh-CN: 该存储将资源变更与 outbox 记录原子提交，但不负责投递事件。

boundary.en: Artifact metadata and outbox records commit atomically in SQL; private files are a separate boundary and the event is not delivered.
boundary.zh-CN: Artifact 元数据与 outbox 记录在 SQL 中原子提交；私有文件属于另一边界，也不负责投递事件。

boundary.en: This store commits its resource change and outbox record atomically; it does not deliver the event.
boundary.zh-CN: 该存储将资源变更与 outbox 记录原子提交，但不负责投递事件。

boundary.en: The pure validator accepts a supplied TaskSnapshot shape; it does not call storage or establish currentness/authorization.
boundary.zh-CN: 纯验证器接受给定 TaskSnapshot 形态；不调用存储，也不证明当前性或授权。

boundary.en: Supplied ArtifactContent is checked for exact pins, owner and bytes; this is not an authorized store read or reusable grant.
boundary.zh-CN: 核对给定 ArtifactContent 的精确引用、所有者与字节；不是授权存储读取或可重用凭据。

boundary.en: Browser metadata is not mapped or accepted through a public command; W11 trusted persistence is a separate path.
boundary.zh-CN: 浏览器元数据尚未映射或通过公共命令准入；W11 可信持久化是独立路径。

boundary.en: Schema-3 storage uses the manifest shape and Task-match contract, not the separate byte verifier; supplied owner/pins remain trusted.
boundary.zh-CN: Schema 3 存储使用清单结构与 Task 匹配契约，不调用独立字节验证器；传入所有者与引用仍依赖可信调用方。

boundary.en: One transaction records the complete Task and manifest in head/outbox; no event delivery or history-recovery API.
boundary.zh-CN: 同一事务在当前记录/outbox 保存完整 Task 与清单；不提供事件投递或历史恢复 API。

boundary.en: No browser save or importer is connected; the W13 router must call W12 authorization, never admit clients directly to the trusted store.
boundary.zh-CN: 未接通浏览器保存或导入；W13 路由必须调用 W12 授权，不直接将客户端交给可信存储。

boundary.en: Each schema-3 content command derives the owner and rechecks exact current Session/account/membership and namespace pins before commit; no public authentication cutover.
boundary.zh-CN: 每条 Schema 3 内容命令派生所有者，并在提交前复查精确当前 Session/账户/成员及命名空间身份；不切换公共认证。

boundary.en: The source-owned transaction borrows schema-3 operations and verifies the complete expected Task/manifest around atomic head/outbox writes; v2 adapters remain separate.
boundary.zh-CN: 认证源拥有的事务借用 Schema 3 操作，在当前记录/outbox 原子写入前后核验完整预期 Task/清单；Schema 2 适配器仍独立。

boundary.en: Read every old/new exact owned revision in one stable order, retain conflicting digests, validate bytes and recheck after mutation, including removed items and empty storage admission.
boundary.zh-CN: 按统一稳定顺序读取旧新所属精确修订，保留冲突摘要，检查字节并在变更后复验，包括移除项及空清单存储准入。

boundary.en: Reuse the pure per-item UTF-8/length/control/digest validator on transaction-read content; metadata labels confer no execution or filesystem access.
boundary.zh-CN: 复用纯逐项 UTF-8/长度/控制符/摘要校验器检查事务读取的内容；元数据标签不授予执行或文件系统访问。

boundary.en: The explicit HTTP router is not mounted or connected to the browser. W14 pure mapping does not supply login issuance, actual publication or save/conflict/outcome UI.
boundary.zh-CN: 显式 HTTP 路由未挂载，也未连接浏览器；W14 纯映射不提供登录签发、实际发布或保存/冲突/结果界面。

boundary.en: Strict HTTP admission dispatches only C2-M source-owned transactions; response text follows confirmed authorized reads, and all dispatched errors remain conservatively unconfirmed.
boundary.zh-CN: 严格 HTTP 准入仅调用 C2-M 认证源同事务命令；正文只来自确认的授权读取，调用后错误保守标记为结果未确认。

boundary.en: Trusted construction supplies the durable source; the dedicated cookie carries its reusable token. HTTP does not issue sessions or grant authority independently of W12.
boundary.zh-CN: 可信构造传入持久认证源，专用 Cookie 携带其可重用 token；HTTP 不签发会话，也不脱离 W12 独立授权。

boundary.en: No normal-app mounting, credential issuer or reviewed deployment/migration path. The live legacy source is not silently reused or switched.
boundary.zh-CN: 没有正常应用挂载、凭据签发或经审阅的部署/迁移路径；不静默复用或切换现用旧认证源。

boundary.en: Only supplied ArtifactContent values are checked against planned bytes, scope and owner; no store call, publication-history proof or reusable authority. Equal-text items do not establish prior reference order.
boundary.zh-CN: 只将给定 ArtifactContent 与计划字节、范围和所有者核对；无存储调用、发布历史证明或可复用权限。相同正文不证明之前的引用顺序。

boundary.en: All supplied items must agree before constructing the existing bounded manifest; checked local IDs/revisions are discarded. No Task write or C2-M authorization is dispatched.
boundary.zh-CN: 全部给定项一致后才构造既有有界清单，校验后的本地 ID/修订丢弃。不派发 Task 写入或 C2-M 授权。

boundary.en: Shared fixtures document format differences, not a browser call to the Rust importer. Browser JSON/BOM/duplicate-field and language-profile behavior stays unchanged; no upload or save route is connected.
boundary.zh-CN: 共享夹具记录格式差异，不是浏览器调用 Rust 导入器。浏览器 JSON/BOM/重复字段及语言配置行为不变，未接上传或保存路由。

boundary.en: A strict plan enters a fixed in-memory attempt; local IDs cannot choose server targets. Preparation has no I/O or authentication.
boundary.zh-CN: 严格计划进入固定内存尝试；本地 ID 不能选择服务端目标，准备不执行 I/O 或认证。

boundary.en: The token fingerprint fixes context, not authority. Every dispatched command rechecks the current account, audited membership and Session.
boundary.zh-CN: token 指纹固定上下文而非权限；各派发命令复查当前账户、审计成员及 Session。

boundary.en: One authorized create per artifact step. Mark unconfirmed before awaiting; retain confirmations and stop after errors/drop, without retry or cleanup.
boundary.zh-CN: 每个制品步骤一个授权创建；等待前记未知，错误/drop 后保留确认并停止，不重试或清理。

boundary.en: A separate Task create follows all Artifact confirmations. C2-O checks original bytes with confirmed metadata; C2-M rereads actual blobs and current authority in its own transaction.
boundary.zh-CN: 全部 Artifact 确认后独立创建 Task；C2-O 检查原字节及确认元数据，C2-M 在自身事务重读真实 blob 并核验当前权限。

boundary.en: The opaque surviving attempt supplies only its fixed unconfirmed step. Observation leaves state and confirmed history unchanged; no recovery or advance follows a match.
boundary.zh-CN: 仍存不透明尝试只提供其固定未知步骤，观察不改状态或确认历史，匹配后不恢复或推进。

boundary.en: The original token fingerprint must match; the existing read transaction independently verifies current Session/account/membership. Re-login cannot take over the attempt.
boundary.zh-CN: 必须匹配原 token 指纹，既有读取事务独立验证当前 Session/账户/成员；重新登录不能接管尝试。

boundary.en: One exact Session Artifact read can return a historical allocated revision; it is not a head check or proof the earlier create committed. Read errors stay typed, not invisible success.
boundary.zh-CN: 一次精确会话 Artifact 读取可返回分配的历史修订；不是 head 检查或先前创建提交证明，读取错误保留类型而不转不可见成功。

boundary.en: One current Task-content read validates current referenced bytes, not a separate historical prefix scan. Missing Task skips Artifact-namespace validation; observations have separate read times and never prove rollback.
boundary.zh-CN: 一次当前 Task 内容读取验证当前引用字节，不另扫历史前缀；Task 缺席跳过 Artifact 命名空间校验。各次观察时点独立，不证明回滚。

boundary.en: Export only allocated targets and reported in-memory progress into a bounded metadata value. No save, token/fingerprint, current authorization or restored attempt; parsed claims can be forged/replayed. The codec invokes neither W16 nor storage; W18 is a separate explicitly authorized operation.
boundary.zh-CN: 仅将已分配目标及报告的内存进度导出为有界元数据值；不保存、不携带token/指纹，不提供当前授权或复活尝试。解析声明可被伪造/回放；codec 不调用 W16 或存储，W18 是另经显式授权的独立操作。

boundary.en: A parsed checkpoint supplies only a reported unconfirmed target and expected metadata. Parsing triggers no read; inspection separately requires trusted source/workspace and current Session, never restores W16 or treats reported progress as a receipt.
boundary.zh-CN: 已解析检查点只提供报告的未知目标及预期元数据；解析不触发读取，检查另需受信任来源/工作区与当前 Session，不恢复 W16，也不将报告进度当作回执。

boundary.en: Existing read transactions independently enforce supplied current Session/account/audited membership and ownership. Scope must match explicit source/workspace; checkpoint data carries no original fingerprint/owner or proof of the historical caller.
boundary.zh-CN: 已有读取事务独立验证给定当前 Session/账号/经审计成员及所有权；范围须匹配显式来源/工作区，检查点没有原指纹/owner，不证明历史调用者。

boundary.en: One exact Artifact revision read, possibly historical, followed by create-profile and hash/length/text checks. No original-body comparison or filename/language storage claim; generic reading may first materialize 1 MiB. Errors remain typed, not NotVisible.
boundary.zh-CN: 一次精确 Artifact 修订读取可为历史修订，再检查创建形式及摘要/长度/文本；不与原正文比较，也不将文件名/语言当存储事实。通用读取可先取得1MiB，错误保留类型而不转NotVisible。

boundary.en: One current Task-content transaction validates current references and compares the full manifest/profile/lengths, not a separate historical-prefix audit. Missing Task skips Artifact namespace; existing empty Task does not. Current agreement never proves rollback, original storage incarnation or retry safety.
boundary.zh-CN: 一次当前 Task 内容事务校验当前引用并比较完整清单/创建形式/长度，不另审历史前缀；缺席 Task 跳过 Artifact 命名空间，已存在空 Task 不跳过。当前一致不证明回滚、原存储代次或重试安全。

boundary.en: Connected in the browser, with mocked Engine shell tests; content is not saved to the server.
boundary.zh-CN: 浏览器内接通，外壳测试模拟 Engine；内容不保存到服务端。

boundary.en: Source-wired workflow; not a fresh real LAN/kernel end-to-end acceptance.
boundary.zh-CN: 源码已接线；不是新执行的真实局域网内核端到端验收。

boundary.en: Compile/probe only; no remote loading, artifact return or implicit local fallback.
boundary.zh-CN: 仅编译探针；不远程加载、不返回目标文件、不隐式本地回退。

boundary.en: Explicit preparatory composition; content publication and Task update are separate operations.
boundary.zh-CN: 显式准备层组合；内容发布与任务更新是分开的操作。

boundary.en: Private owner only; no cross-user review or automatic acceptance.
boundary.zh-CN: 仅私人所有者；无跨用户审阅或自动验收。

boundary.en: Missing browser/public bridge blocks a saved user workflow despite tested backend components.
boundary.zh-CN: 尽管后端组件有测试，缺失的浏览器公共桥仍阻断保存闭环。

boundary.en: Requires an explicit installation/authentication decision and reviewed recovery/migration.
boundary.zh-CN: 需明确安装认证决策并审阅恢复迁移。

label.zh-CN: 缺失的规则审阅与验收

boundary.en: No transitive acceptance from content, catalogue, execution or stored judgment.
boundary.zh-CN: 内容、目录、执行或已存判断都不能传递出验收结论。

boundary.en: Durable orchestration and isolated resource ownership are separate missing boundaries.
boundary.zh-CN: 持久编排与隔离资源归属是两个独立缺口。

boundary.en: Store-side atomicity stops at the outbox; no delivery or replay claim.
boundary.zh-CN: 存储侧原子性止于 outbox；不宣称投递或重放。

boundary.en: Local operator tooling exists; no deployed-data migration, repair or live source switch.
boundary.zh-CN: 本地运维工具已存在；不迁移已部署数据、不修复、不切换在线认证源。

boundary.en: Source/tooling path only; actual target apply and acceptance remain explicit separate work.
boundary.zh-CN: 仅源码工具链路；实际目标 apply 与验收须独立显式执行。

boundary.en: Supplied snapshots only, with Artifact bytes independently checked via e61; no persistence or Session admission.
boundary.zh-CN: 仅给定快照，Artifact 字节另经 e61 检查；不持久化或执行会话准入。

boundary.en: Metadata and exact pins persist atomically in a separate namespace; owner authority, actual bytes and browser saving are not established.
boundary.zh-CN: 元数据与精确引用在独立命名空间原子持久化；不证明所有者权限、实际字节或浏览器保存。

boundary.en: Internal current-Session/text composition on one source-owned transaction, including e68/e69 content checks; public/browser e70 remains missing.
boundary.zh-CN: 认证源同一事务内的当前 Session/文本组合，包括 e68/e69 内容检查；公共/浏览器 e70 仍缺失。

label.zh-CN: 显式 HTTP 到授权内容

boundary.en: Explicit in-process router to real source-owned transactions; no mounted listener, browser path or live authentication deployment is established.
boundary.zh-CN: 显式进程内路由到真实认证源事务；不证明已挂载监听、浏览器流程或在线认证部署。

boundary.en: Supplied content and a strict draft plan yield a matching manifest without I/O. Browser e76 remains missing; matching values do not confirm publication or authorize a Task save.
boundary.zh-CN: 给定内容与严格草稿计划在无 I/O 下生成匹配清单。浏览器 e76 仍缺失，值相符不确认发布，也不授权 Task 保存。

boundary.en: W15 separately invokes publication through W05; I04 is checked by every command. Independent commits and caller-owned in-memory outcomes only, without browser or durable recovery connections.
boundary.zh-CN: W15 另经 W05 发布，各命令检查 I04；仅独立提交与调用者持有内存结果，不接浏览器或持久恢复。
